title: Editor E7: placeable tickets, membership and enroll blocks, checkout gated on a connected account
detail: Split from PROG-E7 on 2026-11-10 when its probe (the 1099 gap) closed with lib/billing/connect-tax.ts. What stays open from E7: the transactional widgets are not placeable blocks. lib/entity-blocks/registry.ts carries booking, contact and donate; tickets, membership and enroll have no block id. Per EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE D-3, ship the capability gate first: a block places freely, and its checkout is refused until the Space owner's Stripe account is ready (lib/billing/connect.ts ConnectStatus.ready, payoutsLive()). Dark behind the existing host_payouts_enabled flag. No live charge in the build or its tests.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=fs.readFileSync("lib/entity-blocks/registry.ts","utf8");const miss=["tickets","membership","enroll"].filter(id=>!new RegExp("[\"\x27]"+id+"[\"\x27]").test(r));if(miss.length){console.error("PROG-E7B: no placeable block for: "+miss.join(", "));process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails today: the entity-block registry has no tickets, membership or enroll ids. Passes once each is registered.
